steps.note: S1.3 lists the eight-row sequence and asserts scratch restoration for arbitrary initial scratch values (quoting the lemma statement at 729), but never gives the net target change (JV+RG)x or why it is independent of the initial side/central vectors, so only the lemma's conclusion is asserted.

The plan only says the network exchanges the banks over F_2; it never states the central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, the side-wire cancellation of intersection-one cases, or the self coefficient one.
No central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 or side cancellation of intersections zero and two appears; S1.5.1 only gives the form value |S cap T|-1, which is a different object.
S1.3 names three stages and the overall map (X,Y)->(-Y,X), but does not give the stage-by-stage states (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) or the forward/inverse/forward roles.
The plan says labels are nested along every edge and counts dimension changes, but gives no per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions (no residual table content).
No treatment of the side edge 2->5: neither <t_X> in t_Y^perp nor the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2 appears; S1.5.1 only says neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal.

S1.5.2 states the only decreasing edges are the central 3->4 edges each losing h, L=Ich, gate contributions telescope (one incoming/one outgoing incidence with same label), and absolute sum Wm-2N+2L; the intermediate totals N for sources and Wm-N for sinks are not spelled out.

No F_2 argument that each nonzero residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating, nor absorption of alternating planes; S2.1.1 only asserts an orthonormal basis of the residual, and S1.5.1 treats nondegeneracy over Q.
S1.5.3 gives L_b/N=100/539 but L_c/N=101/539 is never stated anywhere in the plan, so only half of the sub-step's content is present.

S2.1 method uses additivity of Hamming weight mod four over orthogonal vectors, and S2.1.1 factors the phase-frame change into one kernel per vector of an orthonormal basis of the edge residual; the displayed sum of wt(v)[v.x] is not written out, so credit is moderate.
The plan asserts the translation kernel aI+bX_v as a result but never states that wt(v) is odd, the phase i^{epsilon[v.x]}, or H diag(1,-1) H = X that produces it.

The plan gives one child C^{(x)f} per residual basis vector acting on the f-axis (multi-column) group, with exactly s_c child calls in all, which is the one-factor-per-residual-vector, s_c-factors-total content in different notation.

Only 'fix endpoint signs with Z conjugations and fourth-root phases' and 'every role receives C^{(x)m}' are said; zero-label frame I, the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) carrying C^{-1}, Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k}, and the negated X outputs are not stated.
S1.5.3 states L_b/N<1/2 (quoting 'both are smaller than 1/2'), S1.5.4 derives deficit N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_b m, and S2.1.1 gives s_c<W_c m.
eta_b is named in S1.5.5 but its exact value 339/22587335000000 is never stated.
eta_c and its value 73/19906842167500 do not appear in the plan.
S1.5.5 and S1.6.4.1 state deficit exceeding 20*2^-50 and log m<20 giving m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-eta) and s/W<m^tau, quoting lines 1331-1332; S5.1.1 gives tau=sigma=1-2^-50.
S1.6.1.1 only states the factorization A=E1 Pi E2 (calling it Bruhat) and quotes the lemma statement at 1370; the pivot/elimination proof is not given.
The plan works over Z/q^b but never says a fixed odd prime is chosen to avoid every denominator in a finite table so that the triangular factors stay invertible mod q^b.

The S1.6.1 motivation says lower-triangular changes are cheap via controlled shifts, but the descending-physical-order update (earlier coordinates still holding original values) giving O(V) is not stated, and the cost appears only in motivation text; unsure, so absent.
S1.6.1.2 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j sending (h,d) to (h+d,d) with one interchange per one of Pi, so a recursive calls in all.
Only Delta=ceil(C_0 d^20) and epsilon C_1<1 are mentioned; E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} and C_0=128mB^2 are never defined.
S2.5 asserts arithmetic depth at most Delta without the recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, the leaf bound 8e, or the per-invocation operation count; S2.4 is the time recurrence, a different one.
No unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu or A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}; the plan only asserts the final Delta=o(p) bound.

S2.5 states depth at most Delta, so p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits represent the layer exactly, with Delta=o(p) (quoting 2569), and S5.1.1 lists epsilon C_1<1; the induction giving 2^{-(p+l)} Z[i] and modulus 2^l is only implicit, so credit is moderate.
S2.6 states each row of H has absolute row sum one, so disk arrays map to disk arrays and the final truncation adds error below sqrt2 2^-p while staying in the disk.

summary: P06 is a very detailed tree that quotes many lemma statements but carries few of the checklist's inner derivations. Present (8): L3, P1, P3, R1, R4, M4, S4, S5. Absent (18): the scratch-restoring-network proof details (B1-B4), the residual table and its side-edge, F_2 orthonormal-basis and L_c/N pieces (L1, L2, L4, L5), the odd-weight/H diag H = X and endpoint-27-coordinate repair (P2, P4), eta_b and eta_c values (R2, R3), the elimination proof, odd-prime choice and descending-order triangular cost (M1-M3), and the whole guard-width constants, recurrence and unrolling (S1-S3). No sub-step was found stated contrary to the paper. Borderline calls: L3 (present; sources/sinks totals not spelled out), P1 and P3 (present, notation differs), S4 (present; depth-to-width induction implicit), M3 and B1 (absent; unsure).
